cases.input: Choose the most informative visual representation for an evidence-backed process, comparison and measurement claim set.
requiredBehaviors: prefer diagrams when logic and labels dominate
record the evidence role for every asset
forbiddenBehaviors: plan decorative assets without learning value
change domain claims to fit a visual

cases.input: A real device state is important enough to require one source frame while the general mechanism is better redrawn.
requiredBehaviors: use the source frame only for the real state
separate source and explanatory evidence roles
forbiddenBehaviors: use original frames as default decoration
treat a redrawn illustration as source evidence

cases.input: A scientific diagram has a cautious caption, but its formula uses the wrong denominator and its pathway visually mixes current clinical use with a future research scenario.
requiredBehaviors: treat the diagram itself as a claim carrier
verify formula denominator labels arrows and pathway boundaries against evidence
separate current clinical or regulatory use from research and future scenarios
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the visual because the caption is cautious
let visual logic imply a broader claim than the evidence supports
skillAnchors: Formeln, Nenner, Labels, Pfeile und Pfadgrenzen

cases.input: A visual plan fills empty space with stock AI images and complex diagrams that carry no claim.
requiredBehaviors: return an evidence-bound brief to generators
forbiddenBehaviors: delegate new domain decisions to image generators
skillAnchors: komplexe Diagramme nur um Fläche zu füllen
